stages.title: Sentence skeleton
stages.body: Find the finite verb, subject, object or complement before naming word classes.

stages.title: Functional word classes
stages.body: Classify noun, pronoun, verb, adjective, adverb, determiner, preposition and conjunction by use in context.

stages.title: Countability
stages.body: Distinguish count, mass and count-shift meanings; use measure expressions where needed.

stages.title: Number and agreement cues
stages.body: Handle irregular, zero, plural-only and apparently plural singular nouns.

stages.title: Pronoun case
stages.body: Choose subject, object, possessive and reflexive forms by grammatical role.

stages.title: Pronoun reference
stages.body: Give every pronoun one clear antecedent and repair ambiguity by recasting.

stages.title: Relative clauses
stages.body: Distinguish restrictive from non-restrictive meaning before choosing relative and punctuation.

stages.title: Singular they
stages.body: Accept clear modern singular they while preserving verb and noun-number logic.

stages.title: Adjectives and adverbs
stages.body: Place modifiers beside their targets and distinguish form from function.

stages.title: Comparison
stages.body: Use valid comparative forms and compare like with like.

stages.title: Verb form and transitivity
stages.body: Choose principal parts and test object-taking capacity.

stages.title: Editing and timing
stages.body: Make the smallest valid correction, flag legitimate variation and verify meaning.
